verdict.rationale: First-party docs recommend storing state in HCP Terraform or a remote backend for secure storage and team collaboration. A community user confirms configuring a backend block and re-running terraform init, though they find the bootstrap from local state awkward. Nothing in the pack documents state locking or protection against concurrent runs, which is the core safety half of this story. Missing for 10: any evidence of state locking or concurrency protection, detailed backend configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration of locking behavior.
